definitions.explanation: Rice seasoned with a mixture of vinegar, sugar, and salt, used as the base for sushi. Also called シャリ in sushi restaurant terminology.

examples.japanese: {炊|た}きたてのご{飯|はん}に{酢|す}を{混|ま}ぜて{酢飯|すめし}にする。
examples.english: Mix vinegar into freshly cooked rice to make sushi rice.

examples.japanese: おいしい{寿司|すし}を{作|つく}るには、{酢飯|すめし}の{味|あじ}つけが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: To make delicious sushi, the seasoning of the vinegared rice is important.

notes:
USAGE:
{酢飯|すめし} is the standard term used in cooking. At sushi restaurants, the same rice is called シャリ, which is the professional/insider term.

PREPARATION:
{酢飯|すめし} is made by mixing {合|あ}わせ{酢|ず} (seasoned vinegar — a blend of {酢|す}, {砂糖|さとう}, and {塩|しお}) into hot cooked rice while fanning it to cool.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酢飯|すめし}を{作|つく}る (to make sushi rice)
- {酢飯|すめし}の{味|あじ}つけ (seasoning of sushi rice)
- {酢飯|すめし}を{握|にぎ}る (to shape sushi rice by hand)
